name: pricing-table
title: Pricing Table
description: 2-4 column pricing-tier grid. Each tier is a card with name, price, description, feature list, and a CTA button. The "Most popular" tier gets a highlight border. Server component.
author: ofri-peretz <https://github.com/ofri-peretz>
docs:
## @interlace/pricing-table

Installed to `components/ui/patterns/pricing-table.tsx`.

```tsx
import { /* … */ } from '@/components/ui/patterns/pricing-table';
```

Props, a11y contract, live preview and source: https://ds.interlace.tools/c/pricing-table

Requires the `@interlace/interlace-base` CSS baseline (installed automatically as a registry dependency). For the Interlace look, also add `@interlace/theme`.
